dedupe_keys.name: coes peru pre operational epo and operational eo studies for new generation and transmission projects connecting to the sein

description: COES, the operator of Peru's national interconnected electricity system (SEIN), publishes the pre-operational studies (Estudios de Pre Operatividad, EPO) and related operational studies of projects that connect to the grid. The studies page lists the EPOs with a viewer and downloads, links to the project platform (old and new interactive versions) and a meeting booking for EPOs. Notes on the page explain that procedures started before the amended procedure PR-20 (OSINERGMIN resolution 083-2021-OS/CD of 30 April 2021) continue under the earlier PR-20 of 2013, and that progress of EPOs under the new rules is tracked in a spreadsheet in a 'Estado de Avance EPO' folder. Coverage: Peru, projects connecting to the SEIN. Format and access: study documents and spreadsheets for download, in Spanish; free. Licence: not stated on the page read. Caveats: the list of studies and their contents were not opened; studies are developer submissions reviewed by COES, so formats vary. Simulation uses: planned plants, lines and substations with their connection studies support capacity planning and future network models of Peru's grid. Related records: the other Latin American planning sources in the catalogue, such as EPE Brazil's statistical yearbook (data-epe-electricity-statistical-yearbook-data), cover neighbouring systems.
